title: Calvin Can't Fly
author: Jennifer Berne
intro: Calvin is a young starling. He loves books more than anything!
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.q: What kind of bird is Calvin?

questions.clue: It is a big farm building where animals live.
questions.yes: Calvin was born in a barn.

questions.q: Calvin has a very big family. How many cousins does he have?
The other young birds learned to fly. What did Calvin do?
questions.clue: Calvin always had his beak in a book.

questions.q: How did Calvin feel in the library?
questions.clue: The library was Calvin's favourite place.
questions.yes: The library was where Calvin was happiest.

questions.q: What did the other birds call Calvin?
questions.clue: The name is about Calvin's beak.
questions.yes: They called him "geeky beaky". That was unkind.

questions.q: What time of year was it when the birds got ready to fly south?
questions.clue: It is the season that comes just before winter.
questions.yes: It was autumn, so the birds flew south for the winter.

questions.q: When it was time to go, what did Calvin find out?

options.text: He didn't know how to fly
He had lost his favourite book

questions.clue: Look at the name of the story: "Calvin Can't…"
questions.yes: Calvin had been reading so much, he never learned to fly.

questions.q: How did Calvin's family take him with them?

options.text: They put him in a basket
He rode on a duck's back

questions.clue: His family pulled him through the sky.
questions.yes: They tied strings to Calvin and pulled him along.

questions.clue: It is a huge storm with very strong winds.

questions.q: What told Calvin that a hurricane was coming?

options.text: Very strong wind and bending trees
Snow falling all over the ground
The sun getting very, very hot

questions.clue: Think about what a storm does to the trees.
questions.yes: The wind blew hard and the trees bent.

questions.q: How did Calvin know about hurricanes?

options.text: He had read about them in books
His mum and dad told him

questions.clue: Calvin learned lots of things in the library.
questions.yes: Calvin had read all about hurricanes in his books.

questions.q: Where did the birds hide from the storm?
questions.clue: It is a big hole in the side of a hill or a rock.
questions.yes: They hid in a cave until the storm went past.

questions.q: Calvin jumped and flapped his wings because he was so happy. What happened?

options.text: He fell over in the cave

questions.clue: At the end, Calvin could finally do something new.
questions.yes: Calvin found out he could fly!

questions.q: How did Calvin's reading help his family?

options.text: He kept them safe from the storm
He showed them where to find food

questions.clue: The other birds did not know what a hurricane was. Calvin did.
questions.yes: Because Calvin read books, he knew how to keep everyone safe.
